meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Load feature provenance
node.instructions: Read the feature baseline frontmatter and query referenced runtime trees only through xc-orchestration-runtime. Record provenance and current baseline references in the declared artifact.
node.acceptance: The artifact identifies feature document provenance without directly reading runtime XML.

node.title: Inspect current implementation state
node.instructions: Compare code, executable tests, Git evidence, and feature baselines. Distinguish current implementation facts, approved target intent, evidence-backed drift, and ambiguous conflicts.
node.deliverables: A current-state artifact with evidence and a proposed reconciliation disposition.
node.acceptance: Every proposed difference is traceable and marked as synchronizable, conflicting, or unresolved.

node.title: Resolve reconciliation conflict
node.instructions: Present the code evidence, target baseline, requested work order goal, and proposed options. Record the user decision and add required document-evolution nodes.
node.deliverables: A structured user decision or an explicit blocked condition.
node.acceptance: No ambiguous product-intent conflict proceeds without a recorded decision.

node.title: Finalize feature reconciliation
node.instructions: Record the reconciliation disposition, synchronized baseline references, conflicts, and residual evidence gaps.
node.deliverables: A concise reconciliation result for the enclosing ordinary work order.
node.acceptance: The enclosing work order can select a solution without silently assuming code and baseline agreement.
